flash_694205.description:
UN human rights office adds 61 companies to its database of companies blacklisted over activities in Judea and Samaria, drawing condemnation from Israel.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Sukkot in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_694204.description:
Brooklyn man faces hate-crime charges after allegedly chasing a Jewish victim with a knife while shouting “Heil f---ing Hitler".

flash_222161.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat and the holiday of Sukkot in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Sunday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat and Sukkot at 19:07 Jerusalem time.

Shabbat Shalom and Chag Sameach!

flash_694211.description: Israeli Consulate takes its fight against NAZA to Lincoln Center, challenging the film’s credibility with giant screens.

flash_694210.description: Two Hamas terrorists, including Nukhba platoon commander, eliminated in separate Gaza strikes after violating ceasefire.

flash_694208.description: A woman wearing an 'Israel kills children' T-shirt drew a response from Jewish teenagers outside a kosher bakery in Pico-Robertson, who waved Israeli flags and sang “Am Yisrael Chai."

flash_694206.description: IDF targets Hezbollah weapons storage facility in southern Lebanon after identifying arms used to threaten Israeli soldiers operating in the Security Zone.

flash_694218.description: Haniyeh’s former bodyguard gained UK citizenship before his arrest over an alleged plot to target Jews in Europe and UK.

flash_694217.description: A Telegraph investigation alleges that 53 Palestinians identified as journalists by the BBC had varying ties to Hamas and other terror groups.

flash_694215.description: Security experts tell i24NEWS of the threat from armed Palestinian Authority forces, raising questions about their training, growing numbers and the future of security coordination.

flash_694213.description: Bezalel Zini requests six-hour break from house arrest to visit his brother, Shin Bet Director David Zini, for a family gathering.

flash_694209.description: Pleasant holiday weather set to give way to rain and falling temperatures, forecasters say.

flash_694207.description: Trump rejects Tehran’s seven-day ceasefire plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, as Iran insists Washington must meet its conditions before nuclear talks can resume.

flash_694216.description: NYPD investigates whether three men emerging from a sewer near Netanyahu’s hotel posed a security threat.

flash_694214.description: Belgian intelligence says attacks on a synagogue and Jewish neighborhood were carried out in response to an Iranian call targeting Jewish and Israeli interests worldwide.

flash_694212.description: A new investigation says Abbas Kamel spent all of 67 minutes in Israel warning of a looming Hamas escalation.

flash_694225.description: Terrorist filmed riding the motorcycle carrying Noa Argamani into Gaza on October 7 reportedly killed in Nuseirat, as Israel continues its hunt for the kidnappers.

flash_694224.description: UTJ chairman MK Yakov Asher urges haredi unity, warns against rival parties courting haredi voters.

flash_694223.description: Report: Terrorist who kidnapped Noa Argamani on October 7 is eliminated

flash_694221.description: AI agent reportedly bypasses internet restrictions during OpenAI training run, prompting company to suspend some advanced model training.

flash_694219.description: U.S. Ambassador Mike Huckabee rejected genocide accusations against Israel and blasted New York Mayor Mamdani's threats against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, saying: "You can't silence the truth."

flash_694245.description: Several arrested near RAF Fairford as bomb disposal experts examine vehicles and residents are evacuated, following Iranian threats against US bomber base.

flash_694244.description: Israeli gymnast Artem Dolgopyat won the gold medal in the floor exercise final at the 2026 FIG Artistic World Challenge Cup in Paris today, delivering an impressive routine and earning a score of 14.500 points.

flash_694242.description: Chabad-Lubavitch delegation presented Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with the Four Species and the Lubavitcher Rebbe’s teachings, offering encouragement ahead of his address to the UN General Assembly.

flash_694240.description: Muhammad Gabain, who held nine Israelis captive in Gaza, eliminated in airstrike after working to rebuild Hamas capabilities, plan new attacks.

flash_694238.description: Palestinian Authority workers barred from entering Israeli communities during the holiday, with few exceptions.

flash_694236.description: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich calls for dismantling the Palestinian Authority, warns Ofer Winter's independent run could waste right-wing votes.

flash_694234.description: Material pleasure is not incompatible with spirituality, but it is incomplete without spirituality. It must remain a tool but never become the purpose of our lives.

flash_694232.description: The aravah is not a deficient etrog; it has its own place in the service of God. Remove the aravah from the Four Species, and the mitzvah itself is incomplete.

flash_694230.description: US federal lawsuit alleges Mercy Health subjected Jewish surgeon to years of antisemitic harassment before firing him weeks after the October 7 massacre.

flash_694228.description: Progressives and wokes created a movement that claims to speak for ordinary people but has become socially and culturally alienated and remote from ordinary people, particularly when those people refuse to adopt the politics assigned to them. Opinion.

flash_694226.description: IDF targets Hezbollah drone launch sites, anti-tank missile positions and other infrastructure in southern Lebanon after explosive drone launched toward Israeli soldiers.

flash_694222.description: As NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani renews accusations against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, we must challenge his use of the word 'genocide' and question his silence on Iran’s human rights abuses. Opinion.

flash_694220.description: Pressed repeatedly on whether Hamas is a terrorist organization, Hadash MK Ofer Cassif draws comparison with IDF, declares himself an anti-Zionist.

flash_694267.description: Central Command chief Avi Bluth toured Metzukei Eretz with Binyamin leaders, meeting the 12 families who established the new community.

flash_694266.description: i24News reported on Sunday that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has instructed his interministerial team and the director of the International Law Department at the Office of Legal Counsel and Legislative Affairs to prepare an international legal case against Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

flash_694264.description: A professional security sweep reportedly found signs that surveillance devices may have been installed in Mayor Hanoch Zeibert’s office.

flash_694262.description: Trump expects fresh negotiations with Iran this week despite rejecting Tehran's proposal, while keeping the possibility of further military strikes open.

flash_694260.description: Passengers arriving from Israel face additional baggage inspections at Amsterdam's Schiphol Airport, with items from Judea and Samaria carrying jail time.

flash_694258.description: An artistic interpretation of the annual Jewish Holidays. Part 3 of 3.

flash_694256.description: Jews are Jugglers: roots in the soil, eyes on the stars.

flash_694254.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee celebrates Sukkot in Jerusalem, declaring the city Israel’s eternal capital and discussing plans for a permanent US Embassy building.

flash_694252.description: An old synagogue building in the city of Mariinsk, built in 1896 and later used as a sports club and a post office branch, will be offered for sale for pennies.

flash_694250.description: Bennett, Netanyahu, Ben Gvir and Golan will all run under distinctive Hebrew letters. One party’s request was rejected because it was considered a name of God.

flash_694248.description: New details indicate two IDF reservists were killed while moving a fallen explosive drone away from fellow troops, despite switching off its remote control.

flash_694246.description: In Moses’ blessing to Issachar and Zevulun lies a message to the Jewish people: complete joy is created when each person recognizes the value of the other, and understands that without him the picture is not complete.

flash_694243.description:
Judea and Samaria District police arrested a Palestinian Arab man in his 50s from Shuqba overnight on suspicion of involvement in burglaries at residential homes in Modi'in Illit and the theft of jewelry and cash.

During an operation conducted by the Modi'in Illit police station, accompanied by IDF forces, officers raided the suspect's home. During the search, jewelry believed to have been stolen was seized.

flash_694241.description: From Ashkelon to Samaria, Religious Zionist students, rabbis and communities come together for dancing and music at Simchat Beit Hasho'eva celebrations.

flash_694239.description: What defines an authentic Sage of Israel?

flash_694276.description: Decades after protesting against Hassan Salameh’s deadly terror campaign, National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir met the terrorist in prison and said he would work to see Hassan put to death.

flash_694275.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi tells NBC that Tehran is prepared for a 'doomsday war' with the US but remains willing to pursue diplomacy.

flash_694274.description: Channel 12 reports Netanyahu secretly flew to Abu Dhabi for talks with UAE President Mohammed bin Zayed; the Prime Minister's Office has not commented.

flash_694273.description: Hussein Issa, a student who arrived in the Netherlands a few months ago, was suspended after revealing that he took part in the October 7th massacre.

flash_694272.description: Kan News poll gives Yashar 23 seats, Likud 21 and Bennett-Lapid 11, with both rival blocs tied at 52 seats just one month before Israel's elections.

flash_694271.description: Following the Dutch boycott of Israeli products, Sa'ar orders diplomats in Ramallah to surrender Israeli-issued documents within seven days.

flash_694270.description: New police footage shows the elimination of the terrorist accused of driving the motorcycle used to abduct Noa Argamani and Avinatan Or from the Nova festival.

flash_694269.description: Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya offers to mediate Yemen's conflict, reveals repeated meetings with US officials, and outlines demands for Gaza's future.

flash_694268.description: Israel is reportedly compiling a legal case against Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, focusing on his treatment of the Kurds and his ties to Hamas.

flash_694265.description: Yemeni military: Four Iranian drone and missile experts eliminated in Taizz

flash_694263.description:
The Foreign Ministry announced that it is closely monitoring the situation of Israelis staying in areas of Ethiopia where security tensions have escalated.

"We are examining options for their departure in coordination with local authorities, in accordance with developments and security conditions on the ground," the Foreign Ministry said in a statement.

flash_694261.description: Five men were arrested after three suspicious vans were spotted heading toward RAF Fairford, as British counter-terror police investigate a possible Iranian-linked terror plot.

flash_694259.description: New findings in the investigation into Greek singer Giorgos Mazonakis’s death include AI searches about saving a patient, alerts from his treatment device, and deleted medical records and images recovered by investigators.

flash_694257.description: Amb. Leiter: Neria's life still hangs in the balance

flash_694255.description: Two years after Nasrallah was killed, reports in Arab media point to the difficulty for Naim Qassem to fill the shoes of the leader who ruled for more than three decades.

flash_694253.description: Dozens of hikers were stuck in the village of Samgaon in Nepal, at an altitude of about 3,500 meters, after landslides and extreme weather blocked roads and bridges.

flash_694251.description: Liri Albag reacts to the elimination of Muhamma Gabain, who held her and eight other Israelis hostage in Gaza.

flash_694249.description: Still recovering from a ramming attack, Ofir Engelsman visits the site where childhood friend Neria Leiter was wounded in a similar attack, calling for a new security approach.

flash_694247.description: Rabbi Moshe Hillel Hirsch, leading haredi rabbi, orders urgent action, seeking workable plan to resolve housing crisis.

flash_694278.description: Shin Bet chief David Zini approves a personal security detail for Gadi Eisenkot, while a decision on protection for Yair Golan remains pending.

flash_694277.description: Police arrest a 22-year-old suspect over the pepper-spray attack on a nine-year-old Armenian Christian boy in Jerusalem's Mamilla neighborhood on Yom Kippur.

flash_694285.description: 33-year-old Kitchener man faces a hate-motivated threats charge after police investigate a livestream containing antisemitic threats against Jews.

flash_694284.description: US envoy to the UN calls Iran’s seven-day ceasefire proposal a “pretty cynical attempt" to win sanctions relief and access frozen funds.

flash_694282.description: NBC News reports that eight US Marines suffered injuries including smoke inhalation and concussion symptoms in Iranian missile attack in Hormuz.

flash_694280.description: Trump tells Fox News the US will win the war with Iran soon as Washington and Tehran remain divided over nuclear concessions, Hormuz and a potential deal.

flash_694304.description: AP reports Netanyahu secretly met UAE President bin Zayed to seek a denial of claims he had warned Israel of an impending Hamas attack before October 7.

flash_694303.description: National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir ascends Temple Mount, calling for Israeli sovereignty over the site and declares that Israel is on the path to total victory.

flash_694302.description: The IDF Military Rabbinate distributes 18,500 sukkahs, including 2,200 tactical models designed to conceal troops, and 13,000 Four Species sets.

flash_694301.description: Brandeis Center files federal complaint alleging Jewish professor faced antisemitic harassment, professional retaliation, after reporting discrimination at Duquesne University.

flash_694300.description: The psychological impact of close- quarters urban combat is uniquely devastating. House-to-house fighting is deeply visceral. It involves face-to-face violence, the immediate sight of casualties, and the constant fear of sudden ambush in enclosed spaces. It is avoidable and must be changed. Opinion.

flash_694299.description: Amid escalating tensions over haredi enlistment, Lithuanian-haredi leader Rabbi Dov Landau warns yeshiva students of struggle for Torah study, urges them to continue learning.

flash_694298.description: Over 250 Christian students and emerging leaders attend Passages' Israel Impact Summit, receiving training to support Jewish students, counter misinformation and strengthen ties with Israel.

flash_694297.description: In Florence, I found myself seeing the crucifixion in a totally different way. Opinion.

flash_694296.description: After suffering PTSD from his wartime service tending to the fallen, Rabbi Menachem Perl attends a Sukkot gathering with his emotional support dog.

flash_694295.description: German town's decision to ban new Holocaust memorial stones from its sidewalks sparks outrage, critics accuse local politicians of pushing Nazi victims' memory out of public life.

flash_694294.description: Europe, forever soaked in Jewish blood, boycotts Jewish businesses just as the Nazis did. Op-ed.

flash_694293.description: Nearly three years after October 7, Hamas retains thousands of armed terrorists, maintains tunnel network, manufactures rockets, and smuggles weapons into Gaza.

flash_694292.description: At a festive Sukkot reception attended by diplomats from dozens of countries, Huckabee praises Jerusalem's unique character and 3,000-year history.

flash_694291.description: Autumn arrives during Sukkot holiday as temperatures drop, scattered showers and additional rain system expected.

flash_694290.description: Former Mossad official Eyal Tsir Cohen says Egyptian intelligence officials never mentioned any prior October 7 warning, despite dozens of hours of talks.

flash_694289.description: Video shows Balad chief repeating his controversial remarks days after October 7, contradicting his claim of ignorance about the massacre.

flash_694288.description: Traditional Priestly Blessing ceremony begins at Western Wall, attended by tens of thousands.

flash_694287.description: The UN can blacklist companies. It cannot move the Judean hills, widen Israel’s coastal plain or make strategic vulnerability disappear. Opinion.

flash_694286.description: Hamas sniper Adi Adli Abd Al-Aaser eliminated in southern Gaza after advancing attacks against Israeli forces and civilians.

flash_694283.description: Lebanese media reported that the Air Force carried out a strike this morning in the Wadi Zebqin area of southern Lebanon.

flash_694281.description: Ireland beats Israel 3-0 in a tense Nations League match marked by no handshakes, black armbands and amid political tensions between the two countries.

flash_694279.description: The Wall Street Journal reports that Egyptian intelligence chief Abbas Kamel personally warned Netanyahu about the possibility of an impending Hamas attack days before the October 7, 2023 massacre.

flash_694335.description: Agudat Israel kicks off its election campaign in Bnei Brak as Elyakim Stark apologizes for failing to protect yeshiva students and calls for unity ahead of a critical battle over the future of the haredi public.

flash_694334.description: Following intelligence information, the alert level has been raised for the territorial division and the 99th Division deployed in the Gaza Strip. Senior commanders have been instructed not to leave the sector.

flash_694333.description: Senior Agudat Yisrael officials believe that faction chairman Yitzhak Goldknopf would not vote against a minority government led by Gadi Eisenkot, but would abstain if such a government were formed.

flash_694331.description: Shin Bet files an official complaint with the military censor, demanding that Channel 12 News be held accountable after it reported on the Prime Minister's flight to the UAE while the plane was still in the air.

flash_694329.description: Former Shin Bet chief Ronen Bar announced that he will file a defamation lawsuit against the Prime Minister and demanded the release of the protocols and the schedule of security meetings that preceded the October 7 massacre.

flash_694327.description: RAF Fairford suspects to be released on bail, head of counter-terror police says.

flash_694325.description: The “longstanding red line" isn’t killing Jews - it’s Jews living. Op-ed

flash_694323.description: Noa Argamani announces on X that she has joined Israeli venture capital firm Vine Ventures, writing that she is “excited, a little emotional, and mostly grateful to continue living my life."

flash_694321.description: After it was decided to delay the tender for the construction of 1,234 housing units due to the proximity of the elections, Gali Baharav-Miara reversed course. Smotrich claims: “This is a maneuver."

flash_694319.description:
Yesterday (Sunday), the IDF struck in the Gaza City area and eliminated the terrorist Shadi Abu Hasira, a key money exchanger in Hamas’ military wing.

The terrorist headed the “Geneva" money exchange network, which transferred tens of millions of Israeli shekels in foreign currency to Hamas’ military wing. These funds were used to finance terrorists, restore military infrastructure, and advance attacks against IDF troops. At the same time, the terrorist was involved in commercial activities in the Gaza Strip and managed the company “Gardena Professional", which facilitated his money-transfer activities.

Recently, the terrorist advanced attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians and operated to restore the terrorist organization’s capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorist was eliminated in an aerial strike in order to remove the threat.

flash_694318.description: The court extended the detention of two Qalqilya residents, including an officer in the PA Preventive Security Service, who were arrested on suspicion of involvement in digging a weapons tunnel.

flash_694317.description:
A report that Senate Democrats are expected to release today (Monday) states that Iran has made extensive use of the cryptocurrency USDT to circumvent US sanctions, the Wall Street Journal reported.

According to the report, the currency has become a major means of payment for the Iranian regime and a tool for financing terrorist organizations - including Hezbollah.

flash_694315.description: The dollar rose by 1.088% to 3.066 shekels. The euro strengthened by 0.958% to 3.4877 shekels.

flash_694313.description: Bereaved father Itzik Bonzel lashes out at former hostage Yocheved Lifshitz over her criticism of Netanyahu: 'I wish I could turn back the clock and return you to Hamas,' then apologizes 'Caught up in emotion, I wrote something I didn’t mean.'

flash_694311.description: Updated satellite images from Google Maps show the extensive scale of destruction in the Gaza Strip following the war that began with Hamas’ October 7 attack.

flash_694309.description: Two foreign Jewish activists involved in pro-Palestinian activities in Judea and Samaria face renewed scrutiny of their previously approved aliyah eligibility.

flash_694307.description: When united, the Jewish people are like a bundle of reeds that can’t be easily broken, whereas individual reeds can easily be broken.

flash_694350.description: Bereaved father and Likud candidate responds to the outcry over his comments about released hostage Yocheved Lifshitz: “How low can one go?"

flash_694349.description:
United Torah Judaism chairman MK Yaakov Asher responded to reports that the Gur Hasidic movement is considering abstaining from a vote if Gadi Eisenkot succeeds in forming the next government.

“United Torah Judaism has no desire to bring anyone down or crown anyone, and we do not act out of revenge or any other interests. The only thing guiding us is the directive of the leading rabbis, according to which United Torah Judaism, in all its components, will neither support nor join any government without securing the status of Torah scholars," Asher said.

flash_694347.description:
Iranian news agencies reported an explosion that was heard on Qeshm Island on Monday evening.

Iranian state TV later reported that the blasts were likely warning shots aimed at vessels in violation, and did not provide further details.

flash_694345.description:
The Prime Minister’s Office rejected a report in The Associated Press alleging that Netanyahu specifically requested, during his meeting with UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed, that the UAE President deny a report published earlier this month by Haaretz, stating the UAE President had contacted Netanyahu in late September 2023 to warn him that Hamas was preparing a major attack against Israel.

“Fake news. The visit focused solely on strengthening relations between the two countries and addressing regional challenges," the Prime Minister’s Office said.

flash_694344.description:
Prime Minister’s Benjamin Netanyahu's Office on Monday evening issued a statement about the Prime Minister's Sunday visit to the United Arab Emirates (UAE).

"Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his wife visited the United Arab Emirates yesterday at the invitation of UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed," the statement said.

"The visit focused on strengthening relations between the two countries and addressing regional challenges. The National Security Council director, Mossad chief, military secretary, and political adviser also took part in the visit."

flash_694342.description: 'Why is Israel sanctioned when they provide a lot of our intelligence reports for us?' TalkTV host Alex Phillips blasts Defence Secretary Wes Streeting over the government’s handling of immigration, terrorism and national security.

flash_694340.description: The official news agency of the United Arab Emirates issued a statement stating that President Mohammed bin Zayed met with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and the two discussed strengthening and developing relations between the two countries.

flash_694338.description:
Earlier today (Monday), IDF soldiers operating in southern Lebanon identified two suspects who entered the Security Zone and approached the soldiers.

Following the identifiction, the soldiers opened fire toward the suspects, the suspects were neutralized. No IDF injuries were reported, the incident is under review.

flash_694336.description: Haddad says his QR-code campaign proves the battle for public opinion is far from over. Now, as No. 2 in Amcha Yisrael, he is taking his advocacy fight into politics.

flash_694332.description:
A short while ago, an interceptor was launched toward a suspicious aerial target identified in the area in which IDF soldiers are operating in southern Lebanon. The details are under review.

No sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol.

flash_694330.description: Ambassador Danon says the message to the UN is clear: 'The world will not celebrate antisemitism,' after dozens of countries refuse to participate in event marking 25 years since UN Durban conference.

flash_694326.description: Controversial UN Special Rapporteur apologizes for comments about Holocaust victims, admits she did not know the history of the term 'antisemitism.'

flash_694324.description: Operation completed in the area of Al-Mansouri in the security zone: Troops from the 55th Brigade completed their mission in southern Lebanon.

flash_694322.description:
Overnight (Monday), IDF observation posts and the Israeli Air Force’s Aerial Control Unit identified a drone crossing from the east into Israeli territory in an attempt to smuggle weapons.

Following the identification, IDF soldiers were dispatched to the area and located the drone, which was carrying nine Kalashnikov rifles, magazines, and a handgun.

The weapons were transferred to the security forces for further handling.
